svg.title: VNStock data flow
svg.desc: A generator and PostgreSQL feed landing files and Kafka; Spark and PyFlink process them into a Delta lakehouse (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Features) whose Gold layer is mirrored to MinIO and queried through Trino, all orchestrated by Airflow.
